name: A camera director that picks the volume and shot
body: A CameraDirector system in game-systems/ reads the volumes and shots at level load, finds which volumes contain the player each frame, takes the highest priority (nearest centre on a tie), and gives the rig its settings or switches to the volume's shot. It is the one place that calls lantern:::camera. Platformer asks it for the camera and for the movement basis.
acceptance_criteria: Entering and leaving a volume changes the rig's settings
A level with no volumes behaves as the plain rig
